title: Mehndi green pre-stitched saree for a mehndi
concept_summary: A light, celebratory mehndi concept in a pre-stitched mehndi green saree draped lehenga-style over a sleeveless blouse. Marigold mirror work and gota patti sit sparingly along the pallu and border, keeping the whole airy enough to move and dance in through the evening.

garment_breakdown.overall_form: A pre-stitched saree draped lehenga-style over a sleeveless, deep-backed blouse.
garment_breakdown.silhouette: A skirted lower half carrying the drape, with the pallu falling free from the shoulder.
garment_breakdown.drape_or_layering: The pallu falls loose from the shoulder rather than being pinned tight.
garment_breakdown.key_proportions: A short blouse read against a full skirted drape keeps the line light.

colour_story.palette_summary: A mehndi green ground brightened by marigold.
colour_story.placement: Mehndi green carries the drape and blouse, with marigold picked out through the mirror work.
colour_story.rationale: Green and marigold read festive for a mehndi without weighing the outfit down.

fabrics_and_texture.finish_and_movement: A fine, fluid crepe that keeps the pleats soft and moving.

embellishment_plan.density: Kept minimal and airy, scattered rather than massed.
embellishment_plan.restraint_notes: Wide plain ground is left between motifs so the fabric keeps its movement.

coverage_and_drape.sleeves: The blouse is sleeveless as chosen.
coverage_and_drape.neckline: A softly curved blouse neckline suited to the drape.
coverage_and_drape.back_and_midriff: A deeply cut open back and a bare midriff at the waist.
coverage_and_drape.dupatta_or_saree_drape: A lehenga-style drape worn over a skirted lower half.

interpretation_notes: No specific regional direction was requested; the styling stays broadly bridal.
safeguards: The saree stays a draped garment over a fitted blouse and is never turned into a stitched gown.

styling_notes: Light, movable jewellery suits the mehndi celebration.
Keep the hair styled away from the pallu.
construction_caveats: This is a concept visualisation only and is not a sewing pattern.
It does not guarantee that the garment can be constructed exactly as shown.
image_alt_text: A model in a mehndi green pre-stitched saree draped lehenga-style, with marigold mirror work, a sleeveless blouse and an uncovered head.
